verdicts.reason: A: the order is right (logo, then tagline), but the 'Lumen & Fig' wordmark is shrunk to about 6px and can't be read, while the tagline dominates. That reverses the original hierarchy, and the ellipse is awkwardly clipped at the left edge. B is worse on the same problems: the tagline comes before the brand, and the tiny logo and wordmark are jammed against the period and the right edge of the ellipse with no gap, so they read as an afterthought.
